description.value: Once every 1d4 rounds, an ice elemental can shoot out a bolt of ice towards a single target within 30 feet. The ice elemental must make a ranged touch attack (+4), if it hits, the attack deals 1d6+5 points of ice damage. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 1st level spell (Knowledge: Planes DC 17).

effect: Once every 1d4 rounds, an ice elemental can shoot out a bolt of ice towards a single target within 30 feet. The ice elemental must make a ranged touch attack (+4), if it hits, the attack deals 1d6+5 points of ice damage. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 1st level spell (Knowledge: Planes DC 17).
On hit also resolve Numbing Cold. Blue Magic: Knowledge (planes) DC 17.
Recharge [[1d4]] rounds. Outside an active encounter, restore one charge after the rolled interval.

description.value: A burrowing ice elemental can pass through nonmagical ice and snow as easily as a fish swims through water. Its burrowing leaves behind no tunnel or hole, nor does it create any ripple or other sign of its presence. A control water spell cast on an area containing a burrowing ice elemental flings the elemental back 30 feet, stunning the creature for 1 round unless it succeeds on a DC 15 Fortitude save.

effect: A burrowing ice elemental can pass through nonmagical ice and snow as easily as a fish swims through water. Its burrowing leaves behind no tunnel or hole, nor does it create any ripple or other sign of its presence. A control water spell cast on an area containing a burrowing ice elemental flings the elemental back 30 feet, stunning the creature for 1 round unless it succeeds on a DC 15 Fortitude save.
When control water hits the occupied ice, move back 30 ft. regardless of save. Burrowing leaves no trail.

description.value: This ability works like spider climb spell, but the surfaces the elemental climbs must be icy. The elemental can move across icy surfaces without penalty and does not need to make Acrobatics checks to run or charge on ice.

When an ice elemental deals ice damage to a creature, that creature must succeed on a Fortitude save or be staggered for 1 round. The save DC is listed in the elemental's stat block and is Constitution-based.

Whenever the elemental deals ice damage, resolve this save once.
